messages:
Hannah I.: Quick sync 1: Reso (procurement) wants to move renewal to 9 months, asks for a reseller discount (they're reselling internally), wants VAT on invoices, vendor code, and wants to preview SSO (SAML/Okta) + SOC2 attestation in DocuSign beforehand. Redline: https://docsend.example/reso-renewal
Omar V.: Need numbers. Current ARR = $90k. 9mo pro-rate = $67.5k. Reseller asks for 12% concession off the 9mo because they bundle. If approved total = $59,400. Any objections?
Jules K.: Finance: 12% is outside CSM delegated band; need sales director signoff. VAT on invoice ok, vendor code required for Net45. If they want Net45 we need PO PDF with vendor code and billing entity exactly as our system expects.
FinanceTeam: Also callout: reseller discount impacts rev share model. We'll need revenue share approval and updated invoicing instructions.
Hannah I.: Customer says they want monthly split over 3 invoices (quarterly-ish) and to see SOC2 summary in the DocuSign envelope. Can Legal attach SOC2 summary?
LegalBot: We can attach SOC2 summary as non-negotiable exhibit, not part of main T&Cs. Okta/SAML appendix is fine. We'll prepare doc with minimal attestation and a clause: "Exhibit B (SOC2) is for informational purposes only."
Omar V.: Sales director signoff required for 12% concession. @Jules K. can you route for approval? I'll also ask AM to propose a counter of 10% while we get signoff.
Jules K.: Routing to Director of Sales now. Finance hold: Net45 only with PO + vendor code. Also need reseller's tax ID for VAT handling.
Hannah I.: PO template they asked for (sending to procurement):
``
PO Number: ________
Purchasing Org: Reso Partners LLC
Vendor Code: ________
VAT Number: ________
Billing Entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Contract Term: 9 months
Invoice Schedule: 3 invoices (dates to be confirmed)
Payment Terms: Net45 (with PO)
Total Amount (post concession): $59,400
Billing Contact: billing@reso.example
``
Omar V.: Customer replied: "Routing PO now. Vendor code RP-221. We'll accept 10% if you can expedite sign-off; prefer DocuSign and to preview SOC2 in the envelope."
Jules K.: Director approved up to 10% concession contingent on reseller agreement for revenue share. Finance to confirm rev share split.
FinanceTeam: Confirmed rev share terms needed; if AM/partner agreement signed, finance approves 10% concession. We'll require partner onboarding doc before revenue share flows.
LegalBot: Preparing DocuSign envelope with: 1) Okta SAML appendix, 2) SOC2 summary as Exhibit B, 3) partner attestation checkbox. We will show exhibits inline so procurement sees them pre-sign.
Hannah I.: I'll send customer note: "We can do 9mo with 10% partner concession (final after partner doc). Please send PO PDF with RP-221 and VAT number. We'll send DocuSign with SSO appendix and SOC2 exhibit for preview before signing."
Omar V.: Once PO PDF + signed partner attestation received, billing will schedule 3 invoices and attach PO to first invoice. CC finance@redwood.example.
Hannah I.: Customer confirms PO queued, VAT GB99880011 included, expects DocuSign link in 4 hours. :raised_hands:
Jules K.: Noted. Marking thread as in-flight; will update when PO + partner docs arrive.
LegalBot: Thread status -> in_progress. Reminder set: follow up in 48h if partner doc or PO not received.
